notes.title: Announcement Trailer and Demo Release!
notes.notes:
We are so proud to announce the demo of our new game: Beastkeepers!

[previewyoutube=Ypl8sgHkhBg;full][/previewyoutube]

Beastkeepers is your creature taming adventure at the bottom of the screen. Breed and train powerful creatures, battle enemies, and earn coins. Use them to unlock new creatures, upgrades, and decorations. Grow stronger and progress endlessly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595612/15c9d29b24d515111e883efe60f815e1daf05fde.png[/img]

This demo is a sneak peak of Beastkeepers, to show you how gameplay works, main mechanic and art of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595612/4df419f985a9e105b2e6d547edf8bda145d0e81e.png[/img]

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
